title: A shop's energy, passed between roles
summary: A data scientist, a statistician and a data engineer pass one file between them, each with their own command line, and cancho-tools to read what they print. No glue, no new package: a tool that dislikes the file says why, by rule.
source: A recorded run of the real tools, replayed, on synthetic data (examples/shop-energy/make_data.py): nothing here measures a real shop.

steps.note: Data scientist (ml): I take the file as it came. The tool refuses, and names the row and the rule.
steps.cmd: ml fit --model linear --target kwh --output kwh.ml shop.csv > refusal.json; jsonq -p /error/rule --format text refusal.json; jsonq -p /error/detail --format text refusal.json

steps.note: Statistician (stats): What is wrong with it? Three cells are missing in the target.
steps.cmd: stats describe shop.csv --cols kwh > kwh.json; for k in count missing mean; do echo "$k $(jsonq -p /data/columns/0/$k --format text kwh.json)"; done

steps.note: Data engineer (table): I drop the rows with no reading, and hand the rest on. peek counts the lines: the header and 117 rows.
steps.cmd: table --where "kwh != ''" --format csv shop.csv > clean.csv; peek --count-lines --lines 1:1 clean.csv | jsonq -p /data/total_lines --format text -

steps.note: Statistician (stats): Same question on the clean file: exact figures, with the median.
steps.cmd: stats describe clean.csv --cols kwh > clean.json; for k in count missing mean sd quantiles/2/value; do echo "$k $(jsonq -p /data/columns/0/$k --format text clean.json)"; done

steps.note: Data scientist (ml): Now it fits, and it holds 20% of the rows out to score on.
steps.cmd: ml fit --model linear --target kwh --split train=0.8 --seed 1 --output kwh.ml clean.csv > fit.json; for m in rmse mae r2; do echo "$m $(jsonq -p /data/summary/holdout/metrics/$m --format text fit.json)"; done

steps.note: Reviewer (jsonq, peek): Before this ships: what may each tool do, the reading tools included? The compilers proved it.
steps.cmd: for t in table stats ml jsonq peek; do echo "$t $($t introspect | jsonq -p /authority/effects --format text -)"; done
